query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_manifest ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_pk PRIMARY KEY(digest), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_digest CHECK(digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_size_positive CHECK(size > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_fk_config_blob_digest FOREIGN KEY(config_blob_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_blob(digest);
